packageRules.description: Enable auto-merge for all non-major dependency updates
Only suggest dependency versions that are older than 7 days for security reasons
Suppress the minimum release age for internal libraries
Show only the artifactId in the title of single-dependency pull requests: 'Update junit-jupiter-api to v6' instead of 'Update dependency org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-api to v6'

customManagers.description: Custom regex managers allow you to perform version updates in any text file using Renovate. You simply need to add a dependency directive comment above the line: # renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=githubOrg/repoName versioning=semver-coerced

Custom regex managers allow you to perform version updates in any text file using Renovate. You simply need to add a dependency directive comment above the line: <!-- renovate: datasource=maven depName=com.palantir.javaformat:palantir-java-format versioning=maven -->
